actions.name: Power on
actions.description: Writes the power-on packet over Bluetooth. Protocol from jmbwell/mergbw, unverified on a TG609; the light's state is not confirmed.

actions.name: Power off
actions.description: Writes the power-off packet over Bluetooth. Protocol from jmbwell/mergbw, unverified on a TG609; the light's state is not confirmed.

actions.name: Set color
actions.description: Powers the light on, then writes a hue/saturation colour; a brightness is written only when you set one. Protocol from jmbwell/mergbw, unverified on a TG609.

settings.label: Brightness (%) - optional, left unchanged when empty

actions.name: Set brightness
actions.description: Writes a brightness packet; the power state is left untouched. Protocol from jmbwell/mergbw, unverified on a TG609.

actions.name: Set scene
actions.description: Powers the light on, then selects a built-in scene (1-117). Protocol from jmbwell/mergbw, unverified on a TG609.
